end.summary: Discussed shared responsibility for keeping school clean, green, and safe.
end.parentNote: Anika practised everyday ways to keep school clean, including using bins, cleaning their desk, and not writing on walls. They explained that everyone shares responsibility and later corrected the idea that cleaning is only the cleaning staff’s job. Waste sorting and composting were also discussed; at home, practise sorting banana peels, paper, wrappers, and plastic items into wet and dry waste.
